description:
Intent i029 (SNAPSHOT=s14, branch=timer-dwork-softirq-lock) complete. Two findings verified line-by-line in snapshots/s14, both timer-softirq analogues of the seed's missing-BH-disable invariant and both sibling-confirmed bug families:

FINDING 1 (medium confidence): net/bridge/br_multicast.c:893-921. Lock br->multicast_lock (spin_lock_init at br_multicast.c:1811) is taken with plain spin_lock() at 897 (br_multicast_enable_port, caller br_stp.c:462) and 908 (br_multicast_disable_port, caller br_stp_if.c:121) in process-context STP/netlink port-state paths, while TIMER_SOFTIRQ callbacks take the same lock plainly: br_multicast_group_expired (def 165, lock 170, timer_setup 484), br_multicast_port_group_expired (def 222, lock 229, timer_setup 515), router/querier/query expired callbacks (timer_setup 835-842, 1812-1823; plain locks 549/639/667/681/897/908-region). Sibling process sites on the same lock (860, 1930, 1947, 2054, 2091, 2104, 2143, 2162) correctly use spin_lock_bh, proving mixed discipline and the missing _bh at 897/908. A timer softirq firing on the same CPU spins forever against the preempted holder.

FINDING 2 (medium confidence): drivers/scsi/libiscsi.c:1947-1961. iscsi_eh_cmd_timed_out (scsi eh_timed_out hook, block-layer timeout kworker, BH-enabled process context) takes plain spin_lock(&session->frwd_lock) at 1961 (unlock 2088, walks cmds[] and calls iscsi_send_nopout under it), while TIMER_SOFTIRQ callbacks iscsi_tmf_timedout (def 1799, lock 1804, timer_setup at 2945) and iscsi_check_transport_timeouts (def 2096, lock 2101, timer_setup at 2921, mod_timer 2134) take the same lock; many sibling frwd_lock/back_lock sites use spin_lock_bh (784, 1359, 1387, 1488, 2166, ...), plus additional plain sites at 1064/1173 (unresolved).

Evidence is literal source lines read from s14 with exact line numbers; both are static hypotheses (no compile/lockdep runtime was possible — the tree lacks .config). Bounded limitations: whole-tree timer-callback enumeration (tun, garp/mrp, iwlwifi txq stuck timer, cxgb4 ptp_lock, qdisc perturbation timers, hostap ap_handle_timer, mwl8k/qtnfmac/wilc1000/rsi watchdog/retry/scan timers) was not executed before the finalize directive; libiscsi RX-path plain sites 1064/1173 and hrtimer/delayed_work coverage remain unresolved. The ks7010 seed was not reported. Final artifact: agent-state/findings/i029.json; snapshot_checked: s14 only.
